title: Sam1 and Sam2 Gene Functions in Yeast Cultures
summary: This cluster focuses on the genes Sam1 and Sam2, which are involved in the biosynthesis of AdoMet. Sam1 accumulates in foci and assembles stress granules, while Sam2 colocalizes with Sam1. Both genes are expressed in yeast cultures, which are grown in media containing glucose. The presence of glucose limits Sam1's function. The cluster also includes various chemicals and organisms related to the study of Sam1 and Sam2, such as the National Institutes of Health and Agilent Technologies.
